8 /-! A compact record of the proved geometry of one radial strip:

11 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
12 
13 open Set
14 
15 /-- A radial triangle development with its actual surface correspondence and metric guarantees. -/
16 structure RadialStripTriangle {P : ConvexPolyhedron}
17     (routes : C(unitInterval, P.BoundaryCurve)) (p l r : Plane) where
18   homeomorph : range (closedRouteStripMap routes) ≃ₜ convexHull ℝ ({p, l, r} : Set Plane)
19   radial : ∀ z, (homeomorph ⟨closedRouteStripMap routes z, mem_range_self z⟩ : Plane) = triangleFanMap p l r z
20   inverse_nonexpanding : LipschitzWith 1 (fun z => ((homeomorph.symm z).val : Space))
21   convex_patches : ∀ (patch : Set Space), Convex ℝ patch →
22     ∀ inclusion : C(patch, range (closedRouteStripMap routes)),
23       (∀ x, ((inclusion x).val : Space) = (x : Space)) → Isometry (fun x => (homeomorph (inclusion x) : Plane))
24   flat_patches : ∀ {z : Space} (chart : P.FlatChart z) (patch : Set Plane), Convex ℝ patch →
25     patch ⊆ chart.domain → ∀ inclusion : C(patch, range (closedRouteStripMap routes)),
26       (∀ x, ((inclusion x).val : Space) = chart.map (x : Plane)) →
27         Isometry (fun x => (homeomorph (inclusion x) : Plane))
28   rigid_pieces : HasFiniteRigidPieces (convexHull ℝ ({p, l, r} : Set Plane))
29     (fun z => ((homeomorph.symm z).val : Space))
30 
31 namespace RadialStripTriangle
32 
33 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {routes : C(unitInterval, P.BoundaryCurve)} {p l r : Plane}
34   (D : RadialStripTriangle routes p l r)
35 
36 /-- A straight segment in the triangle folds to a surface route of no greater length. -/
37 theorem surface_distance_le (x y : convexHull ℝ ({p, l, r} : Set Plane)) :
38     P.surfaceDist (D.homeomorph.symm x).val (D.homeomorph.symm y).val ≤ dist (x : Plane) (y : Plane) :=
39   convex_folding_surface_distance _ (convex_convexHull ℝ _)
40     ⟨fun z => (D.homeomorph.symm z).val, continuous_subtype_val.comp D.homeomorph.symm.continuous⟩
41     D.inverse_nonexpanding x y
42 
43 end RadialStripTriangle

45 namespace SixVertexGraph
46 
47 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
48   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
49     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
50 
51 include graph small_faces in
52 theorem face_strip_development (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
53     {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) (routes : C(unitInterval, P.BoundaryCurve))
54     (member : ∀ t, routes t ∈ P.geodesicFiber a (T.closedEdgeTarget edge t))
55     (F : P.Face)
56     (unique_face : ∀ t, ∀ G : P.Face, (T.openEdgeTarget edge t : Space) ∈ G.val → G = F)
57     (p : Plane) (terminal : ∀ t : Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, P.HasTerminalSource (routes (interiorTime t)) F p)
58     (noncollinear : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({P.faceCoordinates F u, P.faceCoordinates F v, p} : Set Plane)) :
59     Nonempty (RadialStripTriangle routes p (P.faceCoordinates F u) (P.faceCoordinates F v)) := by
60   obtain ⟨H, radial, pieces, inverse⟩ := graph.face_strip_triangle_metric small_faces a T edge routes
61     member F unique_face p terminal noncollinear
62   refine ⟨⟨H, radial, inverse, finite_development_patch_isometric _ _ H pieces inverse, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
63   · intro z
64     apply finite_development_flat_patch_isometric _ _ (convex_convexHull ℝ _) H
65       (fun piece : P.FaceDevelopmentPiece F => piece.projectedPlace)
66       (fun piece => piece.projectedPlace_lipschitz) (fun x => ?_) inverse
67     obtain ⟨piece, inside, placed⟩ := pieces x
68     exact ⟨piece, placed.symm.trans (piece.projectedPlace_on_face _ inside).symm⟩
69   · apply HasFiniteRigidPieces.of_family (fun piece : P.FaceDevelopmentPiece F => piece.lift)
70       (fun piece => Isometry.of_dist_eq piece.lift_rigid)
71     intro x
72     obtain ⟨piece, inside, placed⟩ := pieces (H.symm x)
73     rw [H.apply_symm_apply] at placed
74     exact ⟨piece, (piece.lift_place _ inside).symm.trans (congrArg piece.lift placed)⟩
75 
76 end SixVertexGraph

78 namespace EdgeFolding
79 
80 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {center : Space} {facets : P.NormalizedFacets center}
81   {F G : P.Face} (chart : EdgeFolding facets F G) (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
82   (small_faces : ∀ H : P.Face, (H.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
83     (H.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
84 
85 include graph small_faces in
86 theorem hinge_strip_development (shared : P.ShareEdge F G)
87     (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
88     {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) (routes : C(unitInterval, P.BoundaryCurve))
89     (member : ∀ t, routes t ∈ P.geodesicFiber a (T.closedEdgeTarget edge t))
90     (on_edge : ∀ t, (T.openEdgeTarget edge t : Space) ∈ F.val ∩ G.val)
91     (p : Plane) (terminal : ∀ t : Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, chart.HasTerminalSource (routes (interiorTime t)) p)
92     (noncollinear : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({chart.left u, chart.left v, p} : Set Plane)) :
93     Nonempty (RadialStripTriangle routes p (chart.left u) (chart.left v)) := by
94   obtain ⟨H, radial, pieces, inverse⟩ := chart.hinge_strip_triangle_metric graph small_faces shared
95     a T edge routes member on_edge p terminal noncollinear
96   refine ⟨⟨H, radial, inverse, chart.hinge_development_patch_isometric _ _ H pieces inverse, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
97   · intro z
98     apply finite_development_flat_patch_isometric _ _ (convex_convexHull ℝ _) H
99       chart.projectedPiecePlace chart.projectedPiecePlace_lipschitz (fun x => ?_) inverse
100     obtain ⟨piece, inside, placed⟩ := pieces x
101     exact ⟨piece, placed.symm.trans (chart.projectedPiecePlace_on_face piece _ inside).symm⟩
102   · apply HasFiniteRigidPieces.of_family chart.pieceLift
103       (fun piece => Isometry.of_dist_eq (chart.pieceLift_rigid piece))
104     intro x
105     obtain ⟨piece, inside, placed⟩ := pieces (H.symm x)
106     rw [H.apply_symm_apply] at placed
107     exact ⟨piece, (chart.pieceLift_place piece _ inside).symm.trans
108       (congrArg (chart.pieceLift piece) placed)⟩
109 
110 end EdgeFolding
111 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
